```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(rugarch)
library(glmnet)
```

```{r config}
USE_SUBSET <- FALSE
SUBSET_SIZE <- 100
```

```{r load-data}
stock1 <- read.csv("data/stock_1.csv")

stock1 <- stock1 %>%
  group_by(time_id) %>%
  complete(seconds_in_bucket = 0:599) %>%
  arrange(time_id, seconds_in_bucket) %>%
  fill(bid_price1, ask_price1, bid_size1, ask_size1,
       bid_price2, ask_price2, bid_size2, ask_size2,
       .direction = "down") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    WAP = (bid_price1 * ask_size1 + ask_price1 * bid_size1) / (bid_size1 + ask_size1),
    BAS = ask_price1 / bid_price1 - 1,
    num_order = bid_size1 + ask_size1 + bid_size2 + ask_size2
  )

all_time_IDs <- unique(stock1$time_id)

if (USE_SUBSET) {
  set.seed(40)
  time_IDs <- sample(all_time_IDs, SUBSET_SIZE)
} else {
  time_IDs <- all_time_IDs
}
```

```{r log-returns}
log_r_stock1 <- list()

for (i in seq_along(time_IDs)) {
  df <- stock1 %>% filter(time_id == time_IDs[i]) %>% arrange(seconds_in_bucket)
  price <- df$WAP
  secs <- df$seconds_in_bucket
  log_r <- log(price[-1] / price[-length(price)])
  log_r_stock1[[i]] <- tibble(time = secs[-1], log_return = log_r) %>%
    mutate(time_bucket = ceiling(time / 30))
}
```

```{r realised-volatility}
comp_vol <- function(x) sqrt(sum(x^2, na.rm = TRUE))

vol <- list()
for (i in seq_along(time_IDs)) {
  vol[[i]] <- log_r_stock1[[i]] %>%
    group_by(time_bucket) %>%
    summarise(RV = comp_vol(log_return), .groups = "drop")
}
```

```{r predictors}
predictors <- stock1 %>%
  mutate(
    num_order = bid_size1 + ask_size1 + bid_size2 + ask_size2,
    time_bucket = ceiling(seconds_in_bucket / 30)
  ) %>%
  select(time_id, time_bucket, WAP, num_order, BAS)

list_reg <- list()
for (i in seq_along(time_IDs)) {
  list_reg[[i]] <- predictors %>%
    filter(time_id == time_IDs[i], time_bucket %in% 1:20) %>%
    group_by(time_bucket) %>%
    summarise(
      price = mean(WAP, na.rm = TRUE),
      order = mean(num_order, na.rm = TRUE),
      BAS = mean(BAS, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(time_bucket)
}
```

```{r loss-functions}
qlike <- function(actual, pred) {
  actual <- pmax(actual, 1e-8)
  pred <- pmax(pred, 1e-8)
  mean(actual / pred - log(actual / pred) - 1)
}

rmse <- function(actual, pred) sqrt(mean((actual - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r ridge-lambda-tuning}
# Select Ridge lambda using the same rolling windows and QLIKE loss as the
# main evaluation — this avoids the mismatch you'd get from pooled CV
lambda_vals <- c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 0.5, 1)
tuning_results <- data.frame(lambda = lambda_vals, qlike = NA)

for (l in seq_along(lambda_vals)) {
  losses <- c()

  for (i in seq_along(time_IDs)) {
    rv_series <- vol[[i]]$RV

    for (t in 16:19) {
      actual <- rv_series[t + 1]

      train_df <- list_reg[[i]] %>%
        filter(time_bucket %in% (t - 15):(t - 1)) %>%
        select(time_bucket, price, order, BAS) %>%
        inner_join(
          tibble(time_bucket = (t - 15):(t - 1),
                 RV = rv_series[(t - 14):t]),
          by = "time_bucket"
        )

      newdata <- list_reg[[i]] %>%
        filter(time_bucket == t) %>%
        select(price, order, BAS)

      X_train <- as.matrix(train_df %>% select(price, order, BAS))
      y_train <- train_df$RV

      fit <- glmnet(X_train, y_train, alpha = 0, lambda = lambda_vals[l])
      pred <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newx = as.matrix(newdata)))

      losses <- c(losses, qlike(actual, pred))
    }
  }

  tuning_results$qlike[l] <- mean(losses)
}

best_lambda_ridge <- tuning_results$lambda[which.min(tuning_results$qlike)]
cat("Selected Ridge lambda:", best_lambda_ridge, "\n")
```

```{r model-setup}
ewma_lambda <- 0.94  # RiskMetrics standard
wls_decay <- 0.9

spec_garch <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(model = "sGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1)),
  mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(1, 1)),
  distribution.model = "norm"
)

spec_egarch <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(model = "eGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1)),
  mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(1, 1)),
  distribution.model = "norm"
)

pred_ols <- pred_wls <- pred_ridge <- pred_lasso <- c()
pred_ewma <- pred_har <- pred_garch <- pred_egarch <- c()
actuals <- c()
```

```{r rolling-loop}
for (i in seq_along(time_IDs)) {
  rv_series <- vol[[i]]$RV
  returns_full <- log_r_stock1[[i]]$log_return

  for (t in 16:19) {
    actual <- rv_series[t + 1]
    actuals <- c(actuals, actual)
    rv_floor <- mean(rv_series[(t - 15):t]) * 0.1

    train_df <- list_reg[[i]] %>%
      filter(time_bucket %in% (t - 15):(t - 1)) %>%
      select(time_bucket, price, order, BAS) %>%
      inner_join(
        tibble(time_bucket = (t - 15):(t - 1),
               RV = rv_series[(t - 14):t]),
        by = "time_bucket"
      )

    newdata <- list_reg[[i]] %>%
      filter(time_bucket == t) %>%
      select(price, order, BAS)

    fit_ols <- lm(RV ~ price + order + BAS, data = train_df)
    pred_ols <- c(pred_ols, pmax(predict(fit_ols, newdata), rv_floor))

    fit_wls <- lm(RV ~ price + order + BAS, data = train_df,
                  weights = wls_decay ^ seq(nrow(train_df) - 1, 0))
    pred_wls <- c(pred_wls, pmax(predict(fit_wls, newdata), rv_floor))

    X_train <- as.matrix(train_df %>% select(price, order, BAS))
    y_train <- train_df$RV

    fit_ridge <- glmnet(X_train, y_train, alpha = 0, lambda = best_lambda_ridge)
    pred_ridge <- c(pred_ridge, pmax(predict(fit_ridge, newx = as.matrix(newdata)), rv_floor))

    fit_lasso <- glmnet(X_train, y_train, alpha = 1, lambda = 0.01)
    pred_lasso <- c(pred_lasso, pmax(predict(fit_lasso, newx = as.matrix(newdata)), rv_floor))

    start_idx <- which(log_r_stock1[[i]]$time > (t - 16) * 30)[1]
    end_idx <- tail(which(log_r_stock1[[i]]$time <= t * 30), 1)
    returns_window <- returns_full[start_idx:end_idx]
    returns_window <- returns_window[!is.na(returns_window)]

    sigma2 <- returns_window[1]^2
    for (r in returns_window[-1]) {
      sigma2 <- ewma_lambda * sigma2 + (1 - ewma_lambda) * r^2
    }
    pred_ewma <- c(pred_ewma, pmax(sqrt(30 * sigma2), rv_floor))

    start_j <- max(6, t - 15)
    train_lag1 <- train_mean5 <- train_RV <- c()
    for (j in start_j:(t - 1)) {
      train_lag1 <- c(train_lag1, rv_series[j])
      train_mean5 <- c(train_mean5, mean(rv_series[(j - 4):j]))
      train_RV <- c(train_RV, rv_series[j + 1])
    }
    har_df <- data.frame(RV = train_RV, lag1 = train_lag1, mean5 = train_mean5)
    fit_har <- lm(RV ~ lag1 + mean5, data = har_df)
    newdata_har <- data.frame(lag1 = rv_series[t], mean5 = mean(rv_series[(t - 4):t]))
    pred_har <- c(pred_har, pmax(predict(fit_har, newdata_har), rv_floor))

    train_returns <- log_r_stock1[[i]] %>%
      filter(time > (t - 16) * 30, time <= t * 30) %>%
      pull(log_return)

    fit_garch <- tryCatch(
      ugarchfit(spec_garch, data = train_returns, solver = "hybrid"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(fit_garch)) {
      pred_garch <- c(pred_garch, NA)
      pred_egarch <- c(pred_egarch, NA)
      next
    }

    fc <- tryCatch(
      ugarchforecast(fit_garch, n.ahead = 30),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fc)) {
      pred_garch <- c(pred_garch, NA)
    } else {
      pred_garch <- c(pred_garch, pmax(sqrt(sum(sigma(fc)^2)), rv_floor))
    }

    fit_egarch <- tryCatch(
      ugarchfit(spec_egarch, data = train_returns, solver = "hybrid"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(fit_egarch)) {
      pred_egarch <- c(pred_egarch, NA)
    } else {
      fc_e <- tryCatch(
        ugarchforecast(fit_egarch, n.ahead = 30),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(fc_e)) {
        pred_egarch <- c(pred_egarch, NA)
      } else {
        pred_egarch <- c(pred_egarch, pmax(sqrt(sum(sigma(fc_e)^2)), rv_floor))
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r plot-lambda-tuning}
ggplot(tuning_results, aes(x = lambda, y = qlike)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#4f8ef7", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(colour = "#4f8ef7", size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(data = tuning_results[which.min(tuning_results$qlike), ],
             colour = "#00f5c4", size = 4) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Ridge Lambda Selection",
    subtitle = "Green point = selected lambda (lowest QLIKE)",
    x = "Lambda (log scale)",
    y = "Mean QLIKE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

```{r results-main}
key_results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Ridge", "EWMA", "HAR", "EGARCH"),
  QLIKE = c(
    qlike(actuals, pred_ridge),
    qlike(actuals, pred_ewma),
    qlike(actuals, pred_har),
    qlike(actuals, pred_egarch)
  ),
  RMSE = c(
    rmse(actuals, pred_ridge),
    rmse(actuals, pred_ewma),
    rmse(actuals, pred_har),
    rmse(actuals, pred_egarch)
  )
) %>% arrange(QLIKE)

knitr::kable(key_results, digits = 6)
```

```{r plot-results-bar}
key_results %>%
  mutate(Model = reorder(Model, QLIKE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = QLIKE, y = Model)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4f8ef7", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_col(data = . %>% slice_min(QLIKE, n = 1), fill = "darkblue", alpha = 0.9) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Comparison by QLIKE",
    x = "QLIKE",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

```{r plot-ridge}
best_preds_clean <- pred_ridge[!is.na(pred_ridge)]
actuals_clean <- actuals[!is.na(pred_ridge)]

data.frame(Actual = actuals_clean, Predicted = best_preds_clean) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 0.5, colour = "red") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "darkblue",
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Ridge Regression: predicted vs actual volatility",
    x = "Actual RV",
    y = "Predicted RV"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

```{r}
best_egarch_clean <- pred_egarch[!is.na(pred_egarch)]
actuals_egarch_clean <- actuals[!is.na(pred_egarch)]

data.frame(Actual = actuals_egarch_clean, Predicted = best_egarch_clean) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 0.5, colour = "red") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "darkblue",
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "EGARCH: Predicted vs Actual Volatility",
    subtitle = "Dashed line = perfect prediction",
    x = "Actual RV",
    y = "Predicted RV"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

```{r plot-all}
plot_df <- data.frame(
  Actual = rep(actuals, 8),
  Predicted = c(pred_ols, pred_wls, pred_ridge, pred_lasso,
                pred_ewma, pred_har, pred_garch, pred_egarch),
  Model = rep(c("OLS", "WLS", "Ridge", "Lasso",
                "EWMA", "HAR", "GARCH", "EGARCH"),
              each = length(actuals))
) %>% filter(!is.na(Predicted))

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1, size = 0.3, colour = "#00f5c4") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "#4f8ef7",
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ Model, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  labs(title = "Predicted vs actual RV for all models", x = "Actual RV", y = "Predicted RV") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
```

```{r plot-qlike-dist}
n_ids <- length(time_IDs)
n_val <- 4

compute_per_id <- function(preds, acts, n_ids, n_val) {
  sapply(seq_len(n_ids), function(i) {
    idx <- ((i - 1) * n_val + 1):(i * n_val)
    act <- pmax(acts[idx], 1e-8)
    prd <- pmax(preds[idx], 1e-8)
    mean(act / prd - log(act / prd) - 1)
  })
}

boxplot_df <- data.frame(
  QLIKE = c(compute_per_id(pred_ridge, actuals, n_ids, n_val),
            compute_per_id(pred_egarch, actuals, n_ids, n_val)),
  Model = rep(c("Ridge", "EGARCH"), each = n_ids)
)

ggplot(boxplot_df, aes(x = QLIKE, y = Model, fill = Model)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Ridge" = "#00f5c4", "EGARCH" = "#4f8ef7")) +
  labs(title = "QLIKE distribution for Ridge and EGARCH", x = "QLIKE", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
